name: Mah Sing Group Berhad
summary: Mah Sing Group Berhad operates as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in property development. Its business activities are structured across several key divisions. The Property division is responsible for the investment, planning, and construction of residential, commercial, and industrial real estate ventures. Through its Manufacturing division, the group produces and distributes a variety of plastic molded items, in addition to manufacturing gloves. The Investment Holding and Others division provides a range of supporting services, including management, property support, residential construction, hospitality management, and trading building materials. Beyond these core areas, the company also offers financial services like money lending, utility and management provisions, hotel operations, and comprehensive project and property management expertise. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, Mah Sing Group has a significant international presence, conducting operations in Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Australia, Africa, the Philippines, the United States, Turkey, Vietnam, and Thailand.
